'''Darth Norok''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
[[File:Darth_Norok.png|thumb|left|200px|Darth Norok on Manaan]]
[[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Norok was active during the [[third Galactic War]], and was a part of [[Imperial Logistics]] within the [[Sphere of Civil Administration]].<ref name="Recap" /> Whilst leading the [[Sith Order (Sith Empire)|Sith]] involvement in the [[Invasion of Manaan]], he wielded a [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Sith lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] with a [[Crossguard lightsaber/Legends|crossguard]], and wore a red suit of [[Armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="Teaser" /> Ruthless and determined, he never lost a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]].<ref name="Recap" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Norok first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith|Legacy of the Sith]]'', the eighth Digital Expansion to the [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The expansion was released on [[February 15]], [[2022]].

===Gameplay alternatives===
Norok's backstory changes during certain Imperial playthroughs:
*If Acina is Empress then Norok's master is Darth Vowrawn. Otherwise, his master is Darth Shaar.
*If the player killed Shaar and/or Vowrawn on Mek-Sha during the Onslaught expansion then Darth Norok will replace them on the Dark Council.

During the mission, "Decimation", the player can either agree to support Norok's plan to overcharge the Republic guns to deepen the rift between the Republic and the Selkath at the cost of the guns indiscriminately targeting Imperials as well, or just destroy the guns. For the latter option, Norok will attack both the player and Major Anri, resulting in his death.<ref name="Decimation">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Decimation|Manaan}}</ref>

If the former option was chosen, upon their return to the Imperial base, Norok will immediately Force-choke Colonel [[Seeral Korrd]] only for Darth Krovos to intervene, as Korrd is her subordinate, not Norok's. Player can take either Korrd's side or Norok's before Krovos. If the latter option is chosen, the player can follow up by either incapacitating or executing Norok.<ref name="Decimation" />

In Game Update 7.4: Chains in the Dark, if Norok is dead, Krovos will mention that the Sphere of Production and Logistics is suffering a leadership crisis.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Storming the Castle|Kessan's Landing}}</ref>
